## Anywhere

**Put apps and widgets anywhere on the Home Screen, with empty spaces in between, like iOS 18.** Nothing to set up: hold an app and drag it where you want it.

- **Empty spots stay empty.** Move an app away and nothing slides up to fill the gap.
- **Drop it and it stays there.** Nothing else moves.
- **Moves like iOS 18.** Drag onto an app and it steps aside. Hold over the middle of an app to make a folder.
- **Widgets too.** They snap into place and apps make room.
- No settings, and nothing runs in the background.

- **iOS 15 to 17.** Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks. iOS 18 and later already do this.
- Tested on an iPhone 11 Pro Max (iOS 16.2) and an iPhone SE 2nd gen (iOS 17.5.1). iOS 15 runs the same code as iOS 16 but hasn't been tested yet.
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- **Uninstalling is safe.** Your apps pack back together like before, and your saved layout is never changed.
- The dock and folders keep their normal layout, like on iOS 18.
Written from scratch by **Jond-ie**, following how iOS 18 arranges the Home Screen.
